note: The single swap list. To replace a film: copy the new mp4 (720p), poster (jpg) and captions (vtt) into docs/demos/, change the file names below, and push. To publish the 3-minute film: set youtube to the video id (the part after v=). Nothing else needs editing.

films.title: The 3-minute film
films.blurb: TRACE first: a library that sorts itself, a question that wakes a small part, a real recorded search, the honest limits. Then the two companion projects.

films.title: TRACE, scale-led cut
films.blurb: The scale ladder (504.5 million tokens, earlier test), the sealed library sorting itself into groups, a real recorded search, the numbers, and where TRACE does worse than plain search.

films.title: ANIMA, working version
films.blurb: ANIMA is a separate project: a harness that sits around coding agents. A prototype, validated for one kind of job (fixing a bug against hidden tests). TRACE is its memory in a prototype link.

films.title: Reflex
films.blurb: Reflex is a separate prototype that lets an assistant use a real web page by reading the page's structure first. The owner-approved v3 cut.
